title: Tips the world gives
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.text: This floor still hides {n} way through its walls -- maybe more. Stand still beside a wall and feel for a draft. Where the air moves, a stone will give.
There are still {n} hidden ways on this floor. Look for a stone that sits wrong in the wall, and push it. Stand still beside a wall and feel for a draft; where the air moves, a stone will give.
